explanation: Players usually struck the ball with their hips rather than their hands. Mesoamericans were turning latex into rubber more than 3,000 years ago, mixing it with morning glory juice.

claims.text: The Mesoamerican ball game was played with a solid rubber ball.

Players of the Mesoamerican ball game usually struck the ball with their hips.
Mesoamericans were making rubber from latex more than 3,000 years ago.
Mesoamericans made rubber by mixing latex with juice from morning glory vines.
